What it does

Dext exists to end the shoebox of receipts. Photograph a receipt and it extracts the supplier, date, amount and category, then pushes a coded entry into your accounting system. The saving shows up at month end and again at year end when your accountant is not reconstructing a year of paper.

Where the AI actually is

OCR and AI extraction turn photos of receipts into coded entries.

Pros

  • Photograph a receipt and forget it
  • Integrates with major accounting platforms
  • Big time saver at month end

Cons

  • Priced per user, which suits small teams less

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Remodelers & carpenters, Landscapers in mind. Businesses drowning in paper receipts for materials.

Alternatives

  • QuickBooks

    Accounting software most trade businesses end up on.

  • FreshBooks

    Simple invoicing and accounting for very small businesses.

  • Xero

    Cloud accounting with a large add-on marketplace.

  • Expensify

    Expense reporting with automatic receipt scanning.

Prices shown are indicative as of September 2026 and change often. Always confirm on the vendor's own site.
